data.itinerary:
### Day 1: Introduction to Bali
Introduction to Bali and check-in to hotel.

### Day 2: Bali Temple Purification & Melukat Ceremony
Participate in a traditional Balinese purification ceremony at Pura Tirta Empul, followed by a visit to Pura Besakih, the mother temple of Bali.

### Day 3: Ubud Art Village & Cooking Class
Explore the art villages of Ubud, including the wood carvings of Mas, the batik of Tohpati, and the silverwork of Celuk. In the afternoon, take a cooking class to learn how to prepare traditional Balinese dishes.

### Day 4: Sunrise Trekking Mount Batur
Wake up early for a sunrise trek up Mount Batur, an active volcano in Kintamani. Watch the sunrise from the summit and enjoy the stunning views of Lake Batur.

### Day 5: Gili Trawangan, Meno & Air Snorkeling Day Trip
Take a day trip to the Gili Islands, where you can snorkel in the crystal-clear waters and see an array of marine life, including sea turtles and colorful fish.

### Day 6: Lombok Waterfalls Hopping – Sendang Gile, Tiu Kelep & Benang Stokel
Visit three waterfalls in Lombok: Sendang Gile, Tiu Kelep, and Benang Stokel. Enjoy the scenic views and take a swim in the natural pools.

### Day 7: Lombok Slow Life – Sembalun Highland Farm & Yoga
Spend the day in the Sembalun highlands, where you can practice yoga, visit a farm, and enjoy the scenic views of the surrounding countryside.

### Day 8: Komodo Dragon & Padar Island Trekking 3D2N
Take a 3-day, 2-night trip to Komodo Island, where you can see the famous Komodo dragons and trek to the top of Padar Island for stunning views.

### Day 9: Phinisi Cruise Flores Sea Honeymoon 4D3N
Embark on a 4-day, 3-night cruise around the Flores Sea, where you can snorkel, swim, and relax on the deck of a traditional Phinisi boat.

### Day 10: Return to Bali
Return to Bali and spend the day at leisure, relaxing on the beach or exploring the local area.
